source_snapshot.procedure: Boot OS, disable hibernate and remain idle for 24 hours.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; adds measurable idle bounds, heartbeat, reversible settings, dew-point and recovery.

old_problem: Pending items were measurable idle/power thresholds, monitoring cadence and reversible environmental/power-policy settings.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits runtime idle and monitoring bindings, ED-09 keeps chamber work manual, ED-14 preserves the full 24 hours, ED-15 requires signed idle/power/event limits, and ED-17 preserves baseline evidence.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row48 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3084 and actual next row49/history3085 were read.
Elapsed time alone is insufficient: utilization/power/background-task bounds and continuous heartbeat must prove the system stayed awake and truly idle.
Hibernate/sleep changes require recorded original state and rollback.
Power-state, reachability and event evidence is correlated to dry 0C/+5% telemetry; no soak ran.

test_case.purpose: Verify continuous stable awake-idle behavior for 24 hours at cold/high-rail margin without unintended sleep/wake, reboot, hang, management loss or platform event.
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/+5% conditions, apply only approved reversible power settings, maintain the untouched system for 24 hours while recording heartbeat, utilization, power states, sensors, reachability and events, then restore settings and nominal environment.
test_case.expected_result: The system remains continuously awake, reachable and within signed idle/power bounds for 24 hours with expected power-state behavior, no disallowed event and successful rollback/restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the complete timeline and original-setting rollback; a responsive endpoint at hour 24, hidden sleep/reboot or missing idle proof cannot pass.
safety_gate: Qualified chamber/high-rail operator and independent OOB heartbeat
Preserve logs and original power settings
Abort on reachability, moisture, electrical, thermal or severe-event limit
No auto-retry; dry warm-up before access
expected_evidence: Event deltas, rollback, restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: On a limit stop the soak, preserve the outage/state timeline, restore nominal rails, warm/dry, recover services and original power settings, and do not restart automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Sources consistently require a 24-hour idle cold-margin run.

blocked.reason: Idle semantics and recovery are safely parameterized.
